stories.title: Path 1: Central Operational Execution & Share Cannibal Baseline (60% Probability)
stories.short_summary: PayPal achieves operational stabilization via Fastlane adoption, Venmo monetization, and $1.5B in cost discipline while aggressively shrinking share count by ~4.5% annually. Moderate top-line expansion combined with steady margin expansion drives high-quality double-digit Owner Earnings per share compounding.

stories.story_title: Path 2: Competitive Disintermediation & Margin Compression (40% Probability)
stories.title: Path 2: Competitive Disintermediation & Margin Compression (40% Probability)
stories.short_summary: Mobile OS wallet disintermediation (Apple Pay, Google Pay) contracts high-margin Branded Checkout volume (-1.5% YoY) while mix shifts heavily to low-margin Braintree processing. Operating margins compress to 13.8% by Year 5 as transaction yields decline and fixed cost deleverage takes hold, causing per-share Owner Earnings to decay from $5.28 to $3.81.
